item.title: Tropical Storm Lala rakes Hawaii with high winds and rain without making landfall
item.description: Hurricane Lala has weakened to a tropical storm after raking Hawaii without making landfall. But authorities say it has damaged bridges and swept about 100 homes off their foundations othe Big Island.
